meta.score: 0–100 = 50 + clip(z, ±3) × 50/3, z = the weekly HOT / BULL composite (50 = that week's average name)
meta.sampling: per company: first valid weekly score, then the first one at least 11 US sessions later; same sample for both horizons; no selection on outcomes
meta.timing: score at the Friday close (t); entry next session close (t+1); exits t+6 / t+11 (5 / 10-session holds); exact-date prices for USD names, last price within 4 days for non-US names
meta.uncertainty: 95% interval for the mean: 800 resamples of fixed 20-session calendar blocks carrying all stocks together; ≥10 outcomes and ≥5 occupied blocks
meta.baseline: all bands in the same scope/period/horizon; pooled = USD names, event-weighted; QQQ excess = same-date PX_LAST, USD names only
meta.periods: 2024–25 purged at 31-Dec-2025; 2026 is a stability check, not a holdout
limitations: Weekly composite, so successive samples are ~3 weeks apart per name; names and market phases are not independent.
HOT/BULL are coincident-to-lagging on the weekly CCF (see the lead/lag study): read the bands as context, not a forecast.
Fewer than 10 own-stock outcomes → no headline estimate; under 20 is thin.
